# IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN - Roadmap

Status: **PROPOSED - not approved yet. Do not start implementing until Manas approves** (see PROJECT_STATUS.md).
Requirements and open questions (Q1-Q17) live in `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`; decisions in `DECISIONS.md`.

## 0. Guiding principles
* One verifiable milestone at a time; each milestone ends with a test and an entry in `PROJECT_STATUS.md`.
* Everything is regenerated by numbered scripts with fixed seeds (deliverable 9). No manual steps.
* Keep configuration (nominals, ranges, widths, seeds, paths) in one file `config/project.yaml`; no magic numbers in code.
* Verify SPICE plumbing with tiny hand-checkable cases *before* generating 40,000 simulations.

## 1. Proposed repository layout (created in Phase 1, not yet)
```
dvd_project/
  CLAUDE.md  README.md
  context/            # frozen inputs (assignment, slides, models, example netlist, anonymized chat)
  docs/               # PROJECT_CONTEXT, IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN, PROJECT_STATUS, DECISIONS, TEAM_WORKFLOW
  config/project.yaml # nominals, ranges, widths, seeds
  src/dvdml/          # library: sampling, netlists, spice runner, dataset, models, gates, circuit, metrics
  scripts/            # 00_check_env.py ... 12_build_report.py  (run in order)
  netlists/           # generated example netlists (deliverable 2)
  data/               # transistor CSVs (deliverable 1), gate/circuit result CSVs, corner table
  models_saved/       # the 4 chosen models (deliverable 5)
  results/            # tables + figures
  report/             # typed report
  tests/              # pytest tests for sampling, netlist builders, sign conventions, metrics
```

## 2. Phases, tasks, acceptance criteria

### Phase 0 - Repository, context, understanding  (Session 1 - DONE except review)
* Clone repo, anonymize chat, transfer context, privacy scan, docs. **Accept**: Manas approves understanding + plan; repo made private.

### Phase 1 - Environment and SPICE plumbing  (blocks everything)
| Task | Detail | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| 1.1 | Install ngspice (>= 40, with BSIM4 `level=54`) and Python deps (numpy, pandas, scikit-learn, matplotlib, pytorch or lightgbm/xgboost, pyyaml, pytest). Record versions. | `scripts/00_check_env.py` prints versions |
| 1.2 | **Spike**: run the TA example netlist unmodified on `22nm_LP.pm`; check output is parseable. | prints Id/Ig/Is/Ib |
| 1.3 | Decide how to inject per-sample parameters (vth0, toxe, ndep, u0, xj, temperature, VDD): (a) generate a netlist+model-card per sample and run ngspice batch in a process pool; (b) one ngspice `.control` loop using `altermod`. Benchmark both on 100 samples. | chosen + recorded in DECISIONS.md |
| 1.4 | Netlist builders: 4 single-transistor cases, each terminal its own source, `.options gmin=1e-18 abstol=1e-18 reltol=1e-6 vntol=1e-9`, AD = AS = W*Ldiff (Q3). Output parser; current sign convention "into the device" (Id+Ig+Is+Ib = 0). | unit tests: NMOS ON gives Id>0 into drain; sum ~ 0 |
| 1.5 | Failure handling: log non-converged runs, resample so each dataset has exactly N valid rows. | test with forced failure |

### Phase 2 - Transistor datasets and data check  (Part A, step 1)
| Task | Detail | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| 2.1 | Sampler per Section 4 (VDD first; Vd, Vs in [0, VDD]; W in [1,8]xLmin; T in [-40,125]; 5 process params +/-10 % of nominal, separate NMOS/PMOS; Vg/Vb by case). Seeded. | distribution tests (min/max/mean) |
| 2.2 | Generate 4 x 10,000 rows with SPICE. Exact CSV columns `vdd,temp,w,vd,vs,vg,vb,vth0,toxe,ndep,u0,xj,id,ig,is,ib`. | 4 CSVs, 10,000 rows each, no NaN |
| 2.3 | Kirchhoff check per case: relative residual \|sum\| / max\|I\| summary. | report table |
| 2.4 | Three trend plots (OFF current vs T, OFF current vs vth0, Ig vs toxe), using controlled one-at-a-time sweeps (others fixed) so trends are visible. | plots show physically correct trends (see "Expected trends") |
| 2.5 | Inspect target distributions (orders of magnitude, sign changes, near-gmin floor). | notes feed Phase 3 preprocessing |

Expected trends (sanity): Id(OFF) rises with T and falls with vth0 (exponential); Ig rises as toxe falls; if not, debug netlist/params (Q12).

### Phase 3 - ML transistor models  (Part A, step 2)
| Task | Detail | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| 3.1 | Fixed-seed split 70/15/15 per case (store indices). | split files saved |
| 3.2 | Preprocessing: input scaling; targets as sign + log10\|I\| (or asinh), handling Ig/Ib sign changes (Q10). Metrics in linear domain: R2, median and P95 relative error. | metrics module tested on synthetic data |
| 3.3 | Four model families per case (WhatsApp T3). Proposed: **MLP (neural net)**, **gradient-boosted trees (LightGBM/XGBoost)**, **polynomial/kernel ridge or SVR**, **random forest or k-NN**. Tune on validation only. | 4 x 4 comparison table on validation (deliverable 4) |
| 3.4 | Choose best per case on validation; evaluate once on test; predicted-vs-SPICE plots; save 4 model files + preprocessing. | deliverable 5; target R2 > 0.99 |
| 3.5 | Learning curve: smallest dataset size that keeps accuracy (assignment encourages it). | curve plotted; decide whether to change N |
| 3.6 | Inference API `predict(case, features) -> (id, ig, is, ib)` vectorised for Phase 4-5 speed. | unit test |

### Phase 4 - Gate level  (Part B)
| Task | Detail | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| 4.1 | Corner table: 200 corners (VDD, T, one NMOS and one PMOS process draw) saved to CSV with fixed seed; reused by Phase 5 (Q9). | `data/corners.csv` |
| 4.2 | Gate netlists INV, NAND2, NOR2, AND2 (= NAND2 + INV), OR2 (= NOR2 + INV) with named internal nodes (x, y, NAND/NOR output), widths from config (Q2), AD/AS, required options, inputs at exactly 0 / VDD. | netlists generated; logic function verified in SPICE |
| 4.3 | SPICE reference: 18 cases x 200 corners; record leakage (definition Q1), internal node voltages, output voltage. | `data/gate_spice.csv`, 3,600 rows |
| 4.4 | Terminal-voltage derivation per transistor (Vd, Vg, Vs, Vb) from node voltages; choose ON/OFF model by Vg (Q11); sum predicted currents per Q1 definition. | worked example for one case matches hand calculation |
| 4.5 | Compare: table per 18 cases (SPICE median, ML median, bias, median error, P95), log-log parity plot. | deliverables 6, 7 |
| 4.6 | Diagnose largest errors; iterate on Phase 3 only if justified (never train on gate data). | notes for report |

### Phase 5 - Test circuit: 8-bit parity checker  (Part C)
| Task | Detail | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| 5.1 | Design parity netlist (7 XOR2 tree) from the 5 allowed cells; verify logic for all 256 vectors in SPICE (Q8). | truth table check |
| 5.2 | SPICE reference: 256 vectors x 200 corners (51,200 runs); record total leakage. Benchmark runtime first. | `data/circuit_spice.csv` |
| 5.3 | ML hierarchical prediction: propagate logic values through the circuit, look up gate model + Part-B internal voltages (Q6), sum leakages. | per-vector prediction |
| 5.4 | Metrics + parity plot; compare with gate level. | deliverable 8 |

### Phase 6 - Deliverables, report, reproducibility
| Task | Acceptance |
|---|---|

| 6.2 | Typed report with all sections of deliverable 10 (setup incl. simulator version, data generation, models, gate results, circuit results, error analysis, limitations). | report in `report/` |

## 3. Dependencies

```
P0 -> P1 -> P2 -> P3 -----------+
            |                    +--> P4 (4.4/4.5 need P3 models)  -> P5 -> P6
            +-> 4.1-4.3 (gate SPICE side only needs P1) ------------^
```
* Phase 4's SPICE half (4.1-4.3) and Phase 5's SPICE half (5.1-5.2) need only Phase 1 and can run in parallel with Phase 2/3.
* Biggest unknowns: Q1 (leakage definition), Q2 (gate widths), Q6 (internal voltages in Part C) - ask TAs now, since they change Phases 4-5.

## 4. Suggested division of work for four members  (see TEAM_WORKFLOW.md)
| Member role | Owns |
|---|---|
| M1 - SPICE & data | Phase 1, 2 |
| M2 - ML | Phase 3 (can start on early data, e.g. a 500-row pilot) |
| M3 - Gate level | Phase 4 |
| M4 - Circuit & report | Phase 5, 6 |
Because the work is being done interactively with Claude in one chat, this table is a fallback for parallelising.

## 5. Principal risks
| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Orders-of-magnitude range, sign changes -> poor ML accuracy | log/sign target transform, linear-domain metric, per-case tuning |
| Tiny currents near `gmin`/`abstol` floor -> noisy labels | check floor in Phase 2; use Kirchhoff check |
| Simulation time (51,200 circuit runs) | benchmark early; process pool; reuse ngspice sessions |
| Internal-node KCL not balanced by ML currents -> gate-level bias | Q1 measurement choice, report bias explicitly |
| Gate transistors outside training distribution (Vg not exactly 0/VDD, W) | keep widths in 1-8 x Lmin; verify |
| Public repo with course material | make repo private first |
